name: web-testimonial-mosaic-of-black-blue-and-white-cards-with-avatars
title: 'Trusted by Startups' testimonial mosaic in black, royal blue and white cards with square-cropped avatars and CEO titles
whatItIs: A white page with a bold centred heading and grey subline above a three-column mosaic of quote cards in different heights: black, bright blue and white with faint grid lines, each with a short quote, a bold name, a role, and a rounded-square avatar.
whatItMeans: Confident and varied; mixed colours and heights make quotes feel like a wall of voices.
techniques: Alternate black, blue and white fills.
Add faint grid lines to white cards.

vocabulary.definition: Testimonial cards of different sizes interlocked.
A profile photo with softly rounded corners.
Faint lines on a card surface.
